This plot is small and rented, so I do not want to invest too much money in it, but I have some DAP and urea left from what I bought through the cooperative this year that I can spread here. I will plant the local millet seed I saved from last season because improved millet seed is not easy to get in our area, and I do not want to take on debt for it. My family and I will do all the weeding and harvesting ourselves since the plot is too small to justify hiring anyone, and I certainly cannot afford pesticides or irrigation for a plot I do not even own.
